question: What can CereVasc do after owning this invention that it cannot do efficiently with its current platform?
answer: Increase the value of every future CNS therapy delivered through eShunt by controlling exposure rather than merely providing access.

value_propositions.description: Pharma partners require predictable PK. Current eShunt provides ACCESS; this invention provides CONTROLLED EXPOSURE. The difference: access = drug enters CSF; controlled exposure = drug reaches target tissue at predictable concentration for predictable duration.
value_propositions.evidence: 327% median model-derived relative tissue exposure improvement across 100 therapeutic parameter combinations
value_propositions.why_cannot_build_internally: CereVasc's US11850390B2 covers delivery but NOT controlled separation or retention. Internal development would require the same architecture search, PK modeling, and validation that this invention package provides.

value_propositions.description: The architecture benefits antibodies, oligonucleotides, gene therapy vectors, and small molecules — one IP covers all future eShunt therapy partnerships.
value_propositions.why_cannot_build_internally: The platform advantage was not obvious from single-molecule analysis. It required the V8 parameter sweep to confirm.

value_propositions.description: Claims cover CONTROLLED SEPARATION (minimum {min_sep} fraction) — blocks competitors from any architecture that separates drug delivery from drainage.
value_propositions.evidence: Minimum separation for >20% improvement: 0.15. L3-L7 not found in 15 charted patents.
value_propositions.why_cannot_build_internally: If CereVasc doesn't acquire this, a competitor could patent controlled separation and block CereVasc's own follow-on therapy products.

value_propositions.prop: Reduced development risk for therapy partnerships
value_propositions.description: Pre-built PK model, architecture analysis, and validation blueprint reduce pharma partner's development uncertainty.
value_propositions.evidence: 3-compartment model, 8-variant structural stress, N=500 Monte Carlo, N=100 platform test, passage-level patent chart, pre-registered validation experiment
value_propositions.why_cannot_build_internally: This represents 7 iterations of architecture development that CereVasc would need to replicate internally.

value_propositions.description: CereVasc publicly seeks pharma/biotech partners for CNS therapy delivery. This invention makes eShunt more attractive to those partners by providing controlled exposure.
value_propositions.evidence: CereVasc public statements on follow-on products and therapy partnerships; $85M Series C; STRIDE enrollment complete

BUYABLE_requires: Robust model (CONFIRMED: 8/8 structures, N=500 MC, N=100 platform)
Primary-source patent position (CONFIRMED: 102 SURVIVES 15 refs, L3-L7 novel)
Pre-clinical evidence (NOT YET: $50K ovine experiment pre-registered but not executed)
Buyer-specific advantage (CONFIRMED: controlled exposure for pharma partners, platform across 4 classes, IP blocking territory)
buyer_boundary.current_status: 3/4 requirements met. Missing: pre-clinical evidence. The $50K experiment is the single remaining barrier to BUYABLE.
buyer_boundary.stopping_condition: MILESTONE-WORTHY — all model evidence complete; one physical experiment stands between current state and BUYABLE

permanent_language_enforcement.327%: MODEL_DERIVED PK RELATIVE EXPOSURE — not clinical benefit, not therapeutic efficacy
permanent_language_enforcement.platform_advantage: MODEL_DERIVED — confirmed across 100 parameter combinations, not 4 hand-picked examples
permanent_language_enforcement.patent_position: 102 SURVIVES on 15-ref chart (PARTIAL search); 103 leans NON_OBVIOUS (HYPOTHESIS, not legal conclusion)
